landing.faq.a1: No. Anyone can read, search and filter published articles. An account is only needed to write, comment, like and bookmark.
landing.faq.a2: The platform's administration, based on the public Content policy. Nothing goes live without that review.
landing.faq.a3: Up to 6 hours. You get a notice on the site and by email as soon as the decision is out.
landing.faq.a4: You get the reason and the Content policy item involved. You can create a draft from the submitted version, adjust it and resubmit right away, with no waiting.
landing.faq.a5: Yes. The edit becomes a new version, which is also reviewed. Meanwhile, the current version stays live.
landing.faq.a6: Yes. The interface works in Portuguese and English, and every article states its own language.
landing.faq.a7: Nothing. Reading and publishing are free during the MVP.
